classification.difficultyReason: Collect b, 2b and 3b in a full-turn equation and solve the resulting linear equation.

spec.description: Four plain-ended rays; three small marked sectors b, 2b, 3b and a larger left-hand reflex arc labelled 192°. No vertex dot.
spec.mathematics: b+2b+3b+192=360. Drawing proportions are illustrative; sector labels govern the calculation.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}b+2b+3b+192&=360\\6b+192&=360\\6b&=168\\b&=28\end{align*}$$
